subject: Connector roadmap & milestone assignments — CareBridge MAP draft
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@carebridge.health>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@carebridge.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & MAP draft: connector build milestones, owners, target close

Hi Jamie / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I attached a first-pass MAP (20260810-CareBridge-MAP-Draft.xlsx) and a short SDK integration checklist. Key items summarized below and a proposed target close date. Please confirm owners and any missing dependencies.

Summary (high level)
- Target close: 2026-09-30 (proposed)
- Major MAP milestones:
  1) Integration kickoff: API & env access (CareBridge) — owner: Tom Reyes (your eng lead) — target: 2026-08-18
  2) SDK connector dev (Redwood SE) — owner: Dev Patel — target: 2026-09-08
  3) Streaming/tool-calls enablement (end-to-end) — owner: CareBridge eng + Redwood (joint) — target: 2026-09-15
  4) Structured outputs/schema signoff & sample sets — owner: Neha Kapoor (Redwood PM) + CareBridge data lead — target: 2026-09-10
  5) Security & compliance checklist (KMS, logging, retention) — owner: CareBridge security / Redwood security (exchange evidence) — target: 2026-09-20
  6) UAT & acceptance tests (integrated) — owner: CareBridge QA + Redwood CS — target: 2026-09-25

Dependencies called out:
- Staging environment with API keys and sample data from CareBridge (blocking SDK dev)
- Procurement/contract timeline (DocuSign + SOW) — procurement contact cc'd
- Whitelisted IP ranges and KMS key share for encrypted payloads

Next steps I'm proposing:
1) Confirm owners on your side (Tom / data lead / security / procurement) by EOD 2026-08-12
2) Redwood to schedule a 60-min technical kickoff with your eng team (we can do 2026-08-17 or 08-18)
3) We (Dev) will post an SDK/connector backlog and initial test harness by 2026-08-19

Attachments: 20260810-CareBridge-MAP-Draft.xlsx (MAP draft), sdk-integration-checklist.pdf

Thanks — happy to adjust targets if procurement pushes dates.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@carebridge.health>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@carebridge.health>, procurement@carebridge.health
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & MAP draft: connector build milestones, owners, target close

Hi Olga / Marissa —

Thanks for the concise MAP. Quick notes from our side after internal sync:
- We can confirm Tom Reyes as eng owner; he'll be primary for API access and staging.
- Procurement: sending our standard onboarding timeline (attached) — procurement lead asked to see the SOW and data retention terms. Tentatively procurement expects 3 weeks from SOW to signature, which pushes a realistic close to ~2026-10-07 unless we compress approvals.
- Streaming: good to understand Redwood's streaming SLA; Tom wants to review expected token throughput and fallback behavior if the streaming backend fails.

Action items for CareBridge:
- Tom will share API swagger + sample payloads by 2026-08-14
- Procurement to follow up on SOW redlines by 2026-08-24

I attached our procurement timeline (CareBridge-procurement-timeline.pdf). We'll aim to meet the 2026-09-30 target if procurement accelerates; otherwise expect +/-1 week.

—Jamie Liu
Head of Integrations, CareBridge Health
jamie.liu@carebridge.health
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@carebridge.health>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & MAP draft: connector build milestones, owners, target close

Jamie / Olga —

Thanks — wanted to confirm Redwood commitments from an engineering perspective and call out a few technical dependencies.

Planned deliverables (Redwood SE):
- SDK connector skeleton (Python + Node samples) — deliver by 2026-08-19
- CI-based test harness that validates streaming and tool-call hooks against sample payloads — deliver by 2026-08-25
- End-to-end demo with streaming + tool call example (calendar integration example) — demo slot requested for week of 2026-08-31

Blocking dependencies we need from CareBridge:
- Staging hostnames, API tokens (scoped) and sample dataset (PII scrubbed) — need by 2026-08-17 to hit SDK dev targets
- Definition of structured output schema for the 3 key endpoints (clinical_summary, intake_parse, triage_action) — we can draft schemas, but final signoff needed by 2026-09-08
- Expected throughput & sequence lengths for streaming calls (approx tokens/minute) — affects batching config and kernel selection; Tom pls advise

I'll owner the SDK connector dev work (Dev Patel — Redwood SE). I'll post a short public backlog in the Drive folder and tag the issues we need CareBridge to triage.

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@carebridge.health>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & MAP draft: connector build milestones, owners, target close

Team —

Couple of product notes to make integration smoother:
1) Structured outputs — I will draft the initial JSON schema for clinical_summary, intake_parse, triage_action by 2026-08-20 and will add example payloads to the Drive folder. Please treat these as the canonical fixtures for acceptance tests.
2) Tool calling contract: We need to agree on retry semantics and idempotency for external tool calls (CareBridge calendar, pager, downstream EHR write). I'll propose a short contract doc (2 pages) by 2026-08-18.
3) Quality gating: propose we lock on 3 prompt sets/run-throughs and a PASS metric for F1/Precision on extraction fields before we move to UAT.

I'll own structured outputs and acceptance criteria (Neha Kapoor — Redwood PM). Marissa will own rollout coordination and CS handoff.

Subject: Re: Follow-up & MAP draft: connector build milestones, owners, target close

All —

Confirming owners on our side: Tom Reyes (eng lead) is the API/staging owner; Mia Chen (cc'd to procurement in separate thread) will shepherd procurement. We reviewed the targets and agree with the milestones you listed. We will prioritize getting the swagger + token by 2026-08-14 as promised.

Regarding the target close: we will aim for 2026-09-30 and will escalate with procurement to try to close by that date. If procurement requires the full 3-week window, we may slip to 2026-10-07 — we'll update you by 2026-08-24.

Next steps agreed:
- CareBridge to share swagger + sample payloads (Tom) by 2026-08-14
- Redwood: SDK skeleton + test harness deliverables as outlined (Dev)
- Neha: structured output schemas draft by 2026-08-20
- Schedule 60-min tech kickoff: targets 2026-08-17 @ 10:00 PT (Olga to send invite)

Thanks all — looking forward to the kickoff.

—Jamie

Head of Integrations, CareBridge Health
